edits.target: - The answer is one flat, bracket-balanced list `[{...}, {...}]` inside `<answer>` tags. Do not close the list early or leave stray brackets.
edits.content:
- LINE TEMPLATES (copy the shape; every call line has all three keys, each once, and ends `]},`):
  - required only: `{"tool name": "Shazam: songs/get-count", "required parameters": [{"name": "key", "value": "40333609"}], "optional parameters": []},`
  - optional only: `{"tool name": "Genius - Song Lyrics: Videos", "required parameters": [], "optional parameters": [{"name": "artist_id", "value": "16775"}, {"name": "per_page", "value": "15"}]},`
  - both filled: `{"tool name": "Blaze Verify: Verify an email", "required parameters": [{"name": "email", "value": "support@company-domain.com"}], "optional parameters": [{"name": "smtp", "value": "true"}, {"name": "timeout", "value": "10"}]},`
  - The LAST call line ends `]}` with no comma, and the next line is `]</answer>` (the closing `]` is never omitted).
  - A call line never ends in `"},`, `"}` or `], "},`. That is a half-written `optional parameters` key (real zero-score output: `"required parameters": [{"name": "key", "value": "40333609"}], "},`). Always write the full `"optional parameters": [...]` and then `}`.

(e.g. CheapShark `title`, `limit`; Flight Info `FlightNumber`; `Genius - Song Lyrics: Videos` `artist_id`, `per_page`; `The Legend of Zelda: List of The Legend of Zelda games` `name`, `limit`). This holds even when the value is the call's main entity or ID. Before writing each call, read its `Required parameters:` line: if it says `none`, write `"required parameters": []` and put every value in the optional list
